name: gizza-ai/rake-keywords
summary: Extract keywords/keyphrases from a document with the RAKE algorithm.

tool.description: Extract the most relevant keywords and keyphrases from a document using the RAKE (Rapid Automatic Keyword Extraction) algorithm. Set top_n to limit results (0 = all) and max_words to cap phrase length (0 = no cap). Returns ranked keyphrases with RAKE scores.

text.description: The document text to extract keywords from.

top_n.description: Maximum number of keyphrases to return; 0 returns all.

max_words.description: Maximum words per keyphrase; 0 means no limit.
